ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies slipped modestly on the Delta India exchange, with BTC down 0.30% near $83,744 and altcoins in deeper red. Despite a brief Bitcoin rebound above $83k and decoupling from Asian equities, bearish pressure persists amid whale sell‑offs, Binance’s mining pool shutdown, and regulatory actions in South Korea.
